skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Like Illusion
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Like Illusion. The actor plays the role of the maid who guards the treasure. In a sea of roaming shadows of a hundred and one forms, all truest true and falsest false, the willful intruder finds himself endlessly dithering about the stairs.
skins.quote: For a good while, Kazemaru secretly had a paper self 'listening' for her while the script was explained, and was only found out once everyone decided to break for food.
